name: ground-troops
notes: Ground war v4: the mixed ground forces added beside assets/images/ground-forces.png. Demon infantry (anthropomorphised gargoyle-demon soldiers in military attire: helmet over the horns, webbing, armour vest, folded bat wings, barbed tail), demon rocket troopers, a demon heavy tank, and allied rifle and rocket troopers seen from behind. Every value is an input to tools/ground_troops (Go, standard library only). Silhouettes and every animation frame are authored on the texel grid; each unit's selected ComfyUI keyframe (SDXL + pixel-art-xl + LayerDiffuse transparent sprite) contributes a -1/0/+1 shading texture on its body ramp, so all frames stay aligned pixel for pixel. Colours come from the reserved sets of art/families/ground-forces.json so the new units sit in the same family.
style_prompt: pixel art, 16-bit arcade game sprite, single full body character, side view facing right, night lighting, dark muted colours, crisp square pixels, original artwork, centered, isolated
negative_prompt: text, letters, watermark, logo, signature, ui, frame, border, blurry, photo, photorealistic, 3d render, smooth gradient, multiple views, character sheet, grid, sky, horizon, ground, landscape, scenery, blood, gore, wounds, realistic weapons brand, crowd, many characters
